payload.title: Make full-viewport labeling and timeline the permanent app layouts
payload.description: Replace regular versus fullscreen branches with one viewport-sized single-page shell. Remove fullscreen entry/exit buttons and redundant page layouts. Keep compact persistent app navigation and bounded content panels, no document-level scrolling; only intended panels scroll. Labeling retains large readable item text, horizontal classifier cards when needed, per-card metrics below labeling controls, confidence visualization, optional explanations, persistent bottom-left status and bottom-right Skip/Submit. Timeline fills available pane with its inspector closable; pinch zoom only, horizontal pan and ordinary vertical scrolling remain distinct; mouse zoom buttons and Fit remain reachable. Responsive desktop/iPad portrait/landscape, safe-area and on-screen keyboard behavior. Acceptance: no clipped actions, unintended page scroll or hidden item content; label draft retained across drawers; timeline zoom/pan/play/click cursor still work. Reuse successful existing fullscreen CSS rather than redesign from scratch.
